templates.name: Create Communities
templates.description: Provision communities in ALIS with licensed capacity and address information

companyUrl.title: Company Admin URL
companyUrl.description: Full URL to the company page in ALIS admin

templates.name: Sync ALIS Settings
templates.description: Copy settings (checkboxes, dropdowns, and compliance-item properties) from one ALIS Settings page to one or more others — Resident, Care, Medication, Billing, CRM/Prospect, and more (see settingsDestinations.js for the full list and which ones are confirmed ready). Either pick a Category + Company Host + community ID(s), or paste full Settings URLs directly for anything not in the category list yet.

sourceName.title: Source Name
sourceName.description: Display name of the community (or account) to copy settings FROM

category.title: Settings Category (optional)
category.description: One of: resident, care, medication, billing, crmProspect, staff, company, community, connect, evaluations, drugDatabase, billingCenter, residencyAgreement, intacctGl, notifications, calendar, alisHq — see settingsDestinations.js for what each covers and its readiness. Leave blank and paste full URLs below instead if you need a page not yet in this list.

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host (subdomain, required if using Category)

sourceCommunityId.title: Source ALIS Community ID (if using Category, and the category is per-community)

sourceUrl.title: Source Settings URL (optional — overrides Category/Host/Community ID above)
sourceUrl.description: Full URL of the settings page to copy from. Only needed if Category doesn't cover this page yet.

targets.title: Target Communities
targets.description: Communities to apply the settings TO — fill communityId to use the Category above, or url directly to override.

templates.name: Sync GL Accounts
templates.description: Synchronize GL accounts and discount accounts for ownership transitions and account restructuring

billingSettingsUrl.title: Billing Settings URL
billingSettingsUrl.description: Full URL to the billing settings page

items.title: Billing Items
items.description: Billing items and their GL account mappings

templates.name: KPI Export / QBR Pipeline
templates.description: Pull KPI data from the ALIS export API, benchmark against ALIS 500, pull HubSpot ticket history, and generate QBR discussion-point flags

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS admin URL (e.g. "viva" for viva.alisonline.com) — used to build the export API auth username. If this account spans more than one ALIS host (e.g. after a portfolio merge), comma-separate them (e.g. "viva, viva-secondary") — data from every host is pulled and combined into one QBR.

communities.title: Communities (optional)
communities.description: Leave empty to automatically pull every community from every configured host, excluding any with "Training" in the name

host.title: ALIS Host (optional)
host.description: Only needed for a multi-host account — which of the comma-separated Company Hosts above this community belongs to. Defaults to the first host if omitted.

hubspotCompanyId.title: HubSpot Company ID (optional)
hubspotCompanyId.description: Links this KPI pull to the account's HubSpot ticket history for Support Review / Enhancement Requests

templates.name: Weekly Wellness Scorecard
templates.description: Pull clinical-risk indicators (falls, elopement, behavioral incidents, med exceptions, overdue evaluations, staff compliance) for the past week, broken out by AL/MC and community, with trend vs. prior week and ALIS 500 benchmark comparison where published

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS admin URL (e.g. "imagineseniorliving" for imagineseniorliving.alisonline.com). Comma-separate multiple hosts for a multi-host account.

communities.title: Communities (optional)
communities.description: Leave empty to automatically pull every community from every configured host, excluding any with "Training" in the name

host.title: ALIS Host (optional)
host.description: Only needed for a multi-host account — defaults to the first host if omitted.

weekEnding.title: Week Ending (YYYY-MM-DD)
weekEnding.description: The last day of the 7-day window this report covers (e.g. the most recent Sunday)

templates.name: Community Revenue & Occupancy Snapshot
templates.description: Monthly per-community Charges/Credits/Discounts/Net Revenue, Unit Capacity (estimated from ALIS floor plan — Viva's own report sources this from a manually-maintained file ALIS has no API access to, so treat it as directional, not exact), Move-Ins/Move-Outs, Occupancy Unit Days, Census, and PPD (both bases) — stored as history so the Team AM Dashboard can show month-over-month variance, same report shape Viva's finance team was hand-building every month

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS admin URL. Comma-separate multiple hosts for a multi-host account.

communities.title: Communities (optional)
communities.description: Leave empty to automatically pull every community from every configured host, excluding any with "Training" in the name

host.title: ALIS Host (optional)
host.description: Only needed for a multi-host account — defaults to the first host if omitted.

month.title: Month (YYYY-MM)
month.description: The calendar month this snapshot covers — should normally be the most recently closed month

templates.name: Company/Community ALIS Usage Audit
templates.description: For a company (and optionally its communities), compare what was Contracted (HubSpot deal line items), what's Enabled (ALIS Entitlements page), and what's actually Used (ALIS export API activity) feature-by-feature — a visual RAG grid replacing the old manually-maintained roadmap spreadsheet

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host(s) (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS admin URL (e.g. "imagineseniorliving" for imagineseniorliving.alisonline.com). Comma-separate multiple hosts if this company has communities split across more than one ALIS account/URL — communities from every host are compared side by side in one grid.

alisAdminCompanyIds.title: ALIS Admin Company ID(s) (optional)
alisAdminCompanyIds.description: The numeric company ID from admin.alisonline.com/Customers/EntitlementSets/EditCompany/{id} for each host above, in the SAME ORDER as ALIS Company Host(s) — e.g. "353" or "353,412" for two hosts. Leave a position blank ("353,") to skip the Entitlements scrape for that host. Leave the whole field empty to skip Enabled entirely.

hubspotCompanyId.title: HubSpot Company ID (optional)
hubspotCompanyId.description: Leave empty to skip the Contracted column entirely.

communities.title: Communities (optional)
communities.description: Leave empty to automatically pull every non-training, non-canceled community from every configured host

name.title: Community Name
examples: The Gardens at Lake Wellington Assisted Living

host.title: ALIS Host (optional)
host.description: Only needed for a multi-host account — defaults to the first host if omitted.

lookbackDays.title: Usage Lookback Window (days)
lookbackDays.description: How far back to check for real activity (billing, med administration, care tracking, evaluations, staff compliance, observations) when determining whether a feature is actually Used, not just Enabled.

templates.name: ALIS Audit History
templates.description: Pull ALIS's own Audit History log (who changed what, when) across a company, one or more communities, and/or one or more residents — unified into one filterable, timestamp-sorted feed instead of visiting each ALIS page by hand. Filters mirror ALIS's own (date range, Updated By, Type, Notes search).

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS URL (e.g. "imagineseniorliving" for imagineseniorliving.alisonline.com). One host per run — Audit History is pulled directly from that ALIS instance's own pages, not the export API.

includeCompany.title: Include company-wide Audit History
includeCompany.description: Pulls the Communities > Company tab's own Audit History (role/settings changes, company-level activity).

communities.title: Communities (optional)
communities.description: Each community's own Audit History (deposits, contacts, closed periods, etc.).

name.title: Community Name
examples: The Gardens at Lake Wellington Assisted Living

residents.title: Residents (optional)
residents.description: Each resident's own Audit History (incidents, observations, billing/invoice activity, leaves, etc.) — this is the level to target for "triangulate what happened to this specific resident."

startDate.title: Start Date (MM/DD/YYYY, optional)
startDate.description: Same date-range filter as ALIS's own Audit History widget. Leave both dates empty to pull unfiltered (capped at 500 rows per target as a safety limit).

staffId.title: Updated By — ALIS Staff ID (optional)
staffId.description: The numeric staffId from ALIS's own "Updated By" dropdown for this account — not yet looked up automatically, check the account's Audit History page directly for the right ID.

category.title: Type / Category (optional)
category.description: Matches ALIS's own "Type" dropdown values exactly (e.g. "Compliance", "Care", "Deposits", "Profile", "Settings") — case-sensitive, must match one of that account's real options.

notes.title: Notes search (optional)
notes.description: Free-text search within the audit note itself — same as ALIS's own "Notes" filter field.

templates.name: Resident Acuity History
templates.description: Per-resident, per-month care level, care points, and care level fee for one or more communities, exported to Excel (Summary, Monthly Detail, Level/Fee by Month grids, Evaluation Log, Level Fee Schedule, Methodology Notes). For accounts that bill in ALIS, also compares invoiced care charges to the care level fee (care fee variance).

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS URL (e.g. "leisurecare" for leisurecare.alisonline.com).

communities.title: Communities
communities.description: Leave empty to run every community on the host (excluding Training and canceled/suspended). One Excel file per community. Give the ALIS Community ID, or just the community name (exact or a unique partial match) and the ID is looked up for you.

months.title: Number of Months
months.description: How many calendar months to cover, ending with the End Month (the current month is included through today).

endMonth.title: End Month (YYYY-MM)
endMonth.description: Defaults to the current month. Not needed if you want the report to run through today.

careItemNames.title: Care Billing Items (optional)
careItemNames.description: Only used if the account bills in ALIS. Exact billing item names to count as care charges, comma separated. Leave blank to count any item with "care" in its name. Each workbook's Billing Items tab lists every item invoiced and whether it was counted, so run once blank and adjust from there.
examples: AL - Care Plan Fees, Harbor - Care Plan Fees
